evidence.sourceTitle: Systematic Visual Imagination Benchmark (SVIB) official release documentation
evidence.statement: Each episode contains an input and target image generated from compositional scene state under a defined transition rule. Train/test splits measure systematic generalization in an explicit minimal world-model prediction task.
